description: This file is a shell script used to test the behavior of git reflog expiration, pruning, and related commands. It contains test cases that verify correct handling of reflog entries, expiration policies, error cases, and references manipulation within a git repository.

methods.name: check_have
methods.description: Checks if the provided git objects exist in the repository.

methods.name: check_fsck
methods.description: Runs 'git fsck' and verifies output based on the provided argument.

methods.name: corrupt
methods.description: Simulates corruption of a git object to test error handling.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Recovers a corrupted object back into the repository's objects directory.
